observed: On Free, AI Photos › AI Hair Color › Try now › Continue › the curly-haired sample portrait › Custom: the Custom panel opens as a bottom sheet with a grab handle at the top centre, no 「Custom」 title, no ︽ and no ⌄ key, and top corners rounded on both sides. No ✕ ↩ ↪ ✓ row under the panel: the panel (Style, Base Color, Highlight Color, Generate) runs down to the navigation bar and the page holds no close, undo, redo or apply element. Dragging the handle down collapses the panel: the template row, Generate and the room's ✕ ↩ ↪ ✓ row come back; with Solid and a base colour chosen, the collapsed row shows Custom selected.
expected: No ✕ / ✓ or undo / redo row under the panel, rounded top corners, and a way to collapse it: the PM's ⌄ key or, as the Design draws (Design first, Q-17), only a grab handle.

The ✕ ↩ ↪ ✓ row now shows only with the panel collapsed (the room's own row).
